notes.text: Read from the DP map of Route 202 (592 x 416 px). The tile grid starts 8 px in from the left edge: tile (x, y) covers pixels [8 + 16x, 24 + 16x) x [16y, 16y + 16). The half tiles at both side edges are trees and are left out.
Trees: each tile under a trunk or a canopy that hides most of the ground is blocked; the thin top of a canopy that only overhangs the row above is not. The Poke Ball item at (3, 6) is blocked.

Ledges: rows 9 and 18. On the DP map the south ledge looks like row 19, but on the console the player stands at (22, 19) right under it, beside the trees at (21, 19), and the sign at (24, 20) is one row below.
The east tree wall comes in to column 31 at rows 15 to 17: walking east along row 16 stops at column 30 (run r75), and column 30 is open north to row 4.
NPCs stand on the tile under their feet; the sprites rise into the row above. Trainer facings are read from the sprites; the sight range of 4 is a guess.
The Jubilife City connection offset (-30) is an estimate from the stairs; Jubilife's rows 46..47 are drawn blocked, so the two maps are not joined in one world yet.
